securityChanges: Attributed tally count must equal the committed total.
Permissionless settlement consumes a bounded token allowance pre-approved by the campaign owner.
Settlement records its guard before external token calls (checks-effects-interactions).
Settlement state is publicly queryable with is_settled.
Delegate TTL entries can be maintained with bump_delegates.
Owner campaign indexing is O(1) with bounded campaigns_page reads.
Events use the typed contractevent schema.
deploymentNote: Deploy and reseed only after explicit operator approval; this file is not evidence of an on-chain deployment.
